Usage: zealakit info [options]

Print kit metadata: templates, recipes, ecosystems, categories, Discovery
profiles

Options:
  --json                        Print only machine-readable JSON (stdout
                                contains nothing else)
  --ecosystem <ecosystem>       Filter by ecosystem: node, go
  --scope <scope>               Filter by template scope: client, server,
                                hybrid, infrastructure
  --project-type <projectType>  Filter by Discovery project type: ui,
                                server-api, background-worker, complete-product
  --ui-framework <uiFramework>  Filter by UI framework: react, vue, svelte
  --capability <capability>     Filter by Discovery capability: http-api,
                                web-ui, database, external-api,
                                background-processing, auth
  --template <templateId>       Filter by template id: vite-react, vite-vue,
                                vite-svelte, astro-react-client,
                                astro-react-hybrid, next, nuxt, nest, hono,
                                stdlib-api, gin-api, stdlib-worker
  --recipe <recipeId>           Filter by recipe id: biome, eslint, zustand,
                                pinia, nanostores, client-shared-pieces,
                                hookform-zod, vee-validate-zod, kyjs, axios,
                                tanstack-query, antd, mui, shadcn-ui, nuxt-ui,
                                shadcn-vue, storybook, vitest, docker,
                                better-auth, nest-auth, github-actions,
                                type-orm, mikro-orm, drizzle-orm, prisma,
                                postgres, mysql, mongodb, docker-go,
                                github-actions-go, goose, sqlc, redis
  --category <category>         Filter by recipe category: linter, state, ui,
                                form, fetcher, orm, infrastructure, utils,
                                testing, documentation, auth, ci
  --discover                    Include Discovery profiles and keep only
                                Discovery-eligible entries (no questionnaire, no
                                scoring)
  -h, --help                    display help for command
